champion: Extranodal marginal zone lymphoma of the iris
ordered_diagnoses: Extranodal marginal zone lymphoma of the iris
Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma of the iris

s1.syndrome_frame: A vascularized iris mass with ciliary body involvement and anterior chamber angle involvement
salient_findings: 10 × 9 × 3.5-mm, well-delineated, bilobed, vascularized, tan, peripheral iris nodule
key_facts: Patient is a man in his late 60s
Presented for evaluation of a right iris lesion
Visual acuity was 20/25 OU
The eye was pseudophakic
Slitlamp examination showed a vascularized iris nodule
Ultrasonographic biomicroscopy showed ciliary body involvement
Fine-needle aspiration biopsy results showed a monomorphic population of small to medium-sized hyperchromatic lymphocytes
Lymphocytes were CD20+
Few CD3+, reactive T lymphocytes were present
Systemic evaluation showed no other involvement
Staging was T2N0M0

raw.champion: Extranodal marginal zone lymphoma of the iris
raw.rationale: The presence of a monomorphic population of small to medium-sized hyperchromatic lymphocytes that are CD20+ and the absence of systemic involvement are consistent with extranodal marginal zone lymphoma, which is a common type of lymphoma affecting the eye.

rejected.label: Iris lymphoma

rejected.why: Too broad, as it includes various subtypes of lymphoma

rejected.label: Follicular lymphoma of the iris
